name: Bicycle Crunch
prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Square fitness exercise illustration, readable at 280 x 280. Image 1 is a style and character reference only: same man with short dark hair, featureless face, gray T-shirt, dark navy shorts, white socks, gray sneakers; thin outlines, pale blue background with light circle and dark inset frame. Illustrate Bicycle Crunch in one frozen pose. The athlete lies supine with pelvis, lower back and most of upper back resting on the floor. Only ONE shoulder blade lifts slightly off the floor and rotates toward the opposite bent knee; the other shoulder stays on the floor. Both hands rest lightly behind the head, the elbow on the lifted shoulder approaches the opposite knee. One knee is bent and drawn toward the torso; the other leg is straight and hovering just above floor. Do not lift the entire torso into a sit-up. Use a slightly elevated three-quarter side view that makes floor contact of the back, the lifted shoulder and opposite knee clear. Two arms and two legs, correct anatomy, full body, no text, arrows or equipment.
